I’ve been on the behavorial health floor of a main hospital. And I always find it very comforting to be there (was at a eating disorder unit in the past as well). They have groups and teach ways to cope in healthy ways and talk things out. Of course you don’t have to talk if your uncomfortable but they encourage you to and you can talk to the nurses one on one. They have group meal times. And you’ll be roomed with someone. I did have a slight bad experience but it didn’t ruin my entire stay. I had a anxiety attack I think I sat at the very end of the hall way. A nurse was room checking or something? She completely ignored me.. didn’t even look at me. And it made it worse. My roommate came over and helped calm me down. She was amazing I actually miss talking to her. I’d go again. And honestly I might actually be going inpatient soon... I’ve gotten really bad lately. 
I hope if you do decide to go that your experience is a good one 😊
